alias_rule: fixed is the 00 execution, not a second episode or duplicated physical cost

fixed.selection: highest validation CE; exact tie uses lexicographically smallest schedule digest
fixed.runtime: existing FixedSchedule.choose; no actor at ordinary fixed/STOP steps
fixed.scope: best in this 12-schedule library, not an unrestricted optimal fixed policy

greedy.rule: For every legal next action, predict one-step incremental independent utility minus its execution and decision cost from the current public View. Choose the highest strictly positive prediction; otherwise STOP. Exact ties use ACTIONS order.
greedy.value_model_training_data: train-only executed transitions with independent development utility; no test or future executed branch outcome

planner.rule: Deterministic bounded beam search through a train-only learned transition/value model over the same legal public-state actions. Predictions remain labelled predictions. No unexecuted provider outcome or test score is available. Execute only the selected first action, then replan from actual public observations.
planner.cost_rule: Charge every prediction/expansion and any actually executed branch; preserve all unselected work and partially generated artifacts.
planner.rejected_substitute: historical mechanism DP supplied with known neural counterfactual outcomes

retrieval.feature: mean-pooled frozen pinned VLM vision features
retrieval.distance: cosine similarity; exact tie by source SHA256
retrieval.index_population: train-only clusters and approved output bundles
retrieval.return_rule: Return the top-ranked complete bundle meeting the validation-selected threshold; otherwise abstain. No test-labelled reranker.
retrieval.cost_rule: Index acquisition/build/verification/storage and all query encoding/ranking are recorded; build cost is not zero or charged once per arm.

selection.objective: same gamma-2 CE after declared costs
selection.tie_break: lexicographic method ID, then immutable configuration digest
selection.retain: all candidates, validation scores, failed/rejected trials, physical costs and search order
selection.test_usage: all seven methods are reported; the strongest reference identity is fixed before test dispatch
